-- ShopFx: client-only presentation helpers for the shop panel and rows.
-- No gameplay rules here. Purchase requests and telemetry stay on the server side
-- (the server counts shop_opened from the ShopOpened remote and shop_purchases from buys).

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local GameAssets = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameAssets", 10))
local UiTheme = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("UiTheme", 10))

local ShopFx = {}

local OPEN_SCALE = 0.85
local panelTweens: { [Instance]: { Tween } } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) :: any
local rowTweens: { [Instance]: { Tween } } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) :: any
local shakeToken: { [Instance]: number } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) :: any
local shakeOrigin: { [Instance]: UDim2 } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) :: any

local openedRemote: RemoteEvent? = nil
local remoteLookupRunning = false

local function cancelTweens(store: { [Instance]: { Tween } }, key: Instance)
	local list = store[key]
	if list then
		for _, tw in ipairs(list) do
			pcall(function()
				tw:Cancel()
			end)
		end
	end
	store[key] = {}
end

local function track(store: { [Instance]: { Tween } }, key: Instance, tw: Tween)
	local list = store[key]
	if not list then
		list = {}
		store[key] = list
	end
	table.insert(list, tw)
	tw:Play()
end

-- Tries each candidate sound name that exists in GameAssets.Sounds.
local function playAny(names: { string })
	pcall(function()
		local sounds = (GameAssets :: any).Sounds
		for _, name in ipairs(names) do
			if type(sounds) ~= "table" or sounds[name] ~= nil then
				GameAssets.play(name)
				return
			end
		end
	end)
end

local function fireOpened()
	if openedRemote then
		pcall(function()
			(openedRemote :: RemoteEvent):FireServer()
		end)
		return
	end
	if remoteLookupRunning then
		return
	end
	remoteLookupRunning = true
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok = pcall(function()
			local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 10)
			local r = remotes and remotes:WaitForChild("ShopOpened", 5)
			if r and r:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
				openedRemote = r
				r:FireServer()
			end
		end)
		remoteLookupRunning = false
		if not ok then
			openedRemote = nil
		end
	end)
end

local function getScale(panel: GuiObject): UIScale
	local s = panel:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
	if not s then
		s = Instance.new("UIScale")
		s.Parent = panel
	end
	return s :: UIScale
end

function ShopFx.openPanel(panel: GuiObject?, opts: any?)
	if not panel then
		return
	end
	pcall(function()
		cancelTweens(panelTweens, panel)
		local base = panel:GetAttribute("FxBgT")
		if type(base) ~= "number" then
			base = panel.BackgroundTransparency
			panel:SetAttribute("FxBgT", base)
		end
		local scale = getScale(panel)
		scale.Scale = OPEN_SCALE
		panel.BackgroundTransparency = math.min(1, (base :: number) + 0.5)
		panel.Visible = true
		panel.Active = true
		local info = TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
		track(panelTweens, panel, TweenService:Create(scale, info, { Scale = 1 }))
		track(panelTweens, panel, TweenService:Create(panel, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
			BackgroundTransparency = base :: number,
		}))
	end)
	playAny({ "whoosh", "open", "swoosh", "click" })
	fireOpened()
end

function ShopFx.closePanel(panel: GuiObject?, onDone: (() -> ())?)
	if not panel then
		return
	end
	local ok = pcall(function()
		cancelTweens(panelTweens, panel)
		local scale = getScale(panel)
		local tw = TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
			Scale = OPEN_SCALE,
		})
		tw.Completed:Connect(function()
			if onDone then
				pcall(onDone)
			end
		end)
		track(panelTweens, panel, tw)
	end)
	if not ok and onDone then
		pcall(onDone)
	end
end

local function flashRow(row: GuiObject, color: Color3)
	cancelTweens(rowTweens, row)
	local base = row:GetAttribute("FxBaseColor")
	if typeof(base) ~= "Color3" then
		base = row.BackgroundColor3
		row:SetAttribute("FxBaseColor", base)
	end
	row.BackgroundColor3 = base :: Color3
	local up = TweenService:Create(row, TweenInfo.new(0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), { BackgroundColor3 = color })
	local down = TweenService:Create(row, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
		BackgroundColor3 = base :: Color3,
	})
	up.Completed:Connect(function(state)
		if state == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed then
			track(rowTweens, row, down)
		end
	end)
	track(rowTweens, row, up)
end

local function getBar(row: GuiObject): Frame
	local bar = row:FindFirstChild("LevelBar")
	if bar and bar:IsA("Frame") then
		return bar
	end
	local f = Instance.new("Frame")
	f.Name = "LevelBar"
	f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
	f.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
	f.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 6)
	f.BackgroundColor3 = UiTheme.good
	f.BorderSizePixel = 0
	f.ZIndex = row.ZIndex + 2
	local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
	c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 3)
	c.Parent = f
	f.Parent = row
	return f
end

function ShopFx.buySuccess(row: GuiObject?, level: number?, maxLevel: number?)
	if not row then
		return
	end
	playAny({ "buy", "purchase", "cash", "coin", "collect" })
	pcall(function()
		flashRow(row, UiTheme.good)
	end)
	pcall(function()
		local maxL = math.max(1, tonumber(maxLevel) or 1)
		local frac = math.clamp((tonumber(level) or 0) / maxL, 0, 1)
		local bar = getBar(row)
		TweenService:Create(bar, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			Size = UDim2.new(frac, 0, 0, 6),
		}):Play()
	end)
end

function ShopFx.buyFail(row: GuiObject?)
	if not row then
		return
	end
	playAny({ "error", "deny", "denied", "buzz", "fail" })
	pcall(function()
		flashRow(row, UiTheme.bad)
	end)
	pcall(function()
		local origin = shakeOrigin[row]
		if not origin then
			origin = row.Position
			shakeOrigin[row] = origin
		end
		local token = (shakeToken[row] or 0) + 1
		shakeToken[row] = token
		row.Position = origin
		task.spawn(function()
			local offsets = { 8, -8, 6, -6, 3, -3 }
			for _, dx in ipairs(offsets) do
				if shakeToken[row] ~= token then
					return
				end
				local o = shakeOrigin[row]
				pcall(function()
					row.Position = UDim2.new(o.X.Scale, o.X.Offset + dx, o.Y.Scale, o.Y.Offset)
				end)
				task.wait(0.04)
			end
			if shakeToken[row] == token then
				pcall(function()
					row.Position = shakeOrigin[row]
				end)
			end
		end)
	end)
end

return ShopFx

# Lessons
## Design
- Tune early progression so a playtest of roughly 15 seconds can reach the first purchase or milestone. Use a fast starting income or a cheap first upgrade (a few seconds of income). Slow openings leave the buy loop untested and feel dull. Also keep the second purchase within about 20-30s of idle income, by raising per-item value or lowering the price, so the shop and later upgrades get exercised.
- Starting cash must be strictly below the first upgrade's price, never equal to it. An instant spend gives the player no chase and no sense of what cubes are for. Start slightly below the price so the first few collected cubes earn it, within about 10s. Check starter cash against the first cost in config before finishing.
- The first purchase must actually happen in a short playtest, and its counters (e.g. upgrades_bought) must be above 0. If the report lacks them, the first pad is too hard to find or reach. Put it close to the claimed plot's spawn point, off the walking path, and guide the player to it with a beam. Make sure the tutorial step that points to it fires.
- Give per-event feedback for every economy action: a "+N" popup on collect, plus HUD hints for upgrade cost, affordability or progress. Without it, numbers going up feels weak between purchases.
- Give failure feedback as well as success feedback. A pad or button pressed without enough cash needs a red flash, an audible buzz and a "Need $N" toast, debounced to about 1s. A silent denial confuses young players.
- Place trigger pads (buy pads, claim gates, etc.) off the spawn path so walking from spawn never fires them accidentally. They must still be easy to find and reach: guide the player to the first pad with a visible beam or arrow.
- Make moving cubes or other spawned items non-colliding with players (CanCollide = false, or a collision group) and cap their count per area. Otherwise they jitter, stick or knock players around.
- Keep the time to first core-loop activity well inside the playtest window (the probe may last only ~6-15s). Any auto-claim or auto-start fallback should fire within a few seconds (about 3-5s, not 20s), and claim gates should sit near the spawn area, not far outside the plaza. An idle player must still reach the loop quickly. Keep the spec's auto-claim delay and the tested window consistent so the plaza state can still be observed before the claim.
- Budget the whole first-payout path, not just the claim: claim delay + first spawn + conveyor travel (length / speed) should land the first cash-in within about 3-4s of the claim. Use a short, fast conveyor, spawn the first item immediately on claim, and don't leave this borderline.
- Keep tutorial text consistent with the actual flow (e.g. don't say "walk to a gate" if auto-claim happens within seconds). Tutorial steps must be advanced by events that actually occur, or the player is left without guidance. Add a time-based fallback so a step can't stall. A tutorial_reshown counter above 0 means a step stalled. Give a clear objective from second 0, make the steps lead the player to every key feature (buy pad, shop), and check that the guide beam or arrow actually appears (its census count is above 0). If the census shows beams = 0, the guide is invisible: fix the beam creation (attachments, parenting, target lookup), not just its config.
- Feedback should be audible and visible: use verified sound ids from the shared asset table, not weak built-in rbxasset wavs. Add particles or ambient sparkle, and set the bloom threshold low enough that Neon parts glow.
- Shared effect helpers (burst, shake, sound, FOV punch) only matter if gameplay code calls them. Wire each helper to a real event (collect, buy, rebirth, big upgrade) and check that its counter is above 0 after a playtest. 	label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	label.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 70)
	label.Size = UDim2.new(0, 320, 0, 40)
	label.BackgroundColor3 = UiTheme.bad
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
	label.BorderSizePixel = 0
	label.Text = message
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	label.ZIndex = 100
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	corner.Parent = label
	local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8)
	pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8)
	pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 6)
	pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 6)
	pad.Parent = label
	label.Parent = gui
	currentToast = label
	task.delay(1.6, function()
		if label.Parent then
			pcall(function()
				TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.3), { BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextTransparency = 1 }):Play()
			end)
			task.wait(0.35)
			if label.Parent then
				label:Destroy()
			end
			if currentToast == label then
				currentToast = nil
			end
		end
	end)
end

function ShopFx.buySuccess(row: GuiObject?, level: number?, maxLevel: number?)
	if not row then
		return
	end
	playAny({ "buy", "purchase", "cash", "coin", "collect" })
	pcall(function()
		flashRow(row, UiTheme.good)
	end)
	pcall(function()
		local maxL = math.max(1, tonumber(maxLevel) or 1)
		local frac = math.clamp((tonumber(level) or 0) / maxL, 0, 1)
		local bar = getBar(row)
		TweenService:Create(bar, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			Size = UDim2.new(frac, 0, 0, 6),
		}):Play()
	end)
end

function ShopFx.buyFail(row: GuiObject?, reason: string?)
	if not row then
		return
	end
	playAny({ "error", "deny", "denied", "buzz", "fail", "hurt", "click" })
	pcall(function()
		flashRow(row, UiTheme.bad)
	end)
	pcall(function()
		showToast(row, (type(reason) == "string" and reason ~= "") and reason or "Can't buy that yet")
	end)
	pcall(function()
		-- The row's own Position is controlled by a UIListLayout, so shake its children instead.
		local origins = shakeOrigin[row]
		if not origins then
			origins = {}
			shakeOrigin[row] = origins
		end
		-- restore anything mid-shake
		for obj, pos in pairs(origins) do
			if obj.Parent then
				obj.Position = pos
			end
		end
		for _, child in ipairs(row:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("GuiObject") and origins[child] == nil then
				origins[child] = child.Position
			end
		end
		local token = (shakeToken[row] or 0) + 1
		shakeToken[row] = token
		task.spawn(function()
			local offsets = { 8, -8, 6, -6, 3, -3 }
			for _, dx in ipairs(offsets) do
				if shakeToken[row] ~= token then
					return
				end
				for obj, o in pairs(origins) do
					if obj.Parent then
						pcall(function()
							obj.Position = UDim2.new(o.X.Scale, o.X.Offset + dx, o.Y.Scale, o.Y.Offset)
						end)
					end
				end
				task.wait(0.04)
			end
			if shakeToken[row] == token then
				for obj, o in pairs(origins) do
					if obj.Parent then
						pcall(function()
							obj.Position = o
						end)
					end
				end
			end
		end)
	end)
end

return ShopFx
